title: How to Add Blink Cloud to Cursor: Full-Stack Infrastructure in 2 Minutes
summary: Add database, auth, and production hosting to Cursor in one command. npx skills add blink-new/blink-plugin gives your agent 80+ MCP tools and 14 skills instantly.
body_markdown: It downloads 14 skill files (teaching your agent each Blink Cloud capability), 4 subagent configurations (full-stack-builder, frontend-developer, backend-developer, verifier), persistent coding rules for Blink SDK usage, and the MCP server configuration pointing to Blink Cloud's 80+ tools. Everything writes to your Cursor workspace automatically — no manual file editing needed.
